# ubiops_file (Resource)

Manages a file in a UbiOps bucket. Creates an empty file placeholder.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ubiops_file" "example" {
  project_name = "my-project"
  bucket_name  = "my-bucket"
  file         = "data/input.json"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket_name` (String) The name of the bucket.
- `file` (String) Name of the file
- `project_name` (String) The name of the project.

### Read-Only

- `size` (Number) Size of the file in bytes
- `time_created` (String) The time that the file was created

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import ubiops_file.example my-project/my-bucket/data/input.json
```
